title: Implement Trie
description: Prefix tree of nested objects: each character is a key, an `end` flag marks a complete word.

notes: search vs startsWith differ ONLY in whether you require the terminal node.end flag.
Use Object.create(null) (not {}) so input characters like "__proto__" cannot collide with the prototype chain — a classic interview follow-up.
Pick a terminal sentinel that cannot collide with a character — `end` works for ASCII words; Symbol/$ is safer for arbitrary input.

questions.q: What is the only difference between search and startsWith?
options: search additionally requires the terminal node end flag

questions.q: Time complexity of insert(word) where word has length L?
After inserting "apple" only, what does search("app") return?
questions.explain: The node at "app" exists but its end flag was never set.

questions.q: Common interview follow-up: which input character would BREAK a Trie using plain `{}`?
questions.explain: "__proto__" walks the prototype chain on a plain object — use Object.create(null) to avoid the collision.

blanks.hint: word matches only when end flag set
prefix exists regardless of end flag

L3.prompt: Implement a Trie with insert, search, startsWith. Run: insert("apple"), log search("apple"), log search("app"), log startsWith("app"), insert("app"), log search("app").
hints: search requires the end flag; startsWith only requires the path to exist.
